method: Each kept wallet's daily net Up buying was matched against six simple habits (always Up, always Down, follow the crowd, fade the crowd, follow yesterday's move, bet against yesterday's move). A wallet gets a rule only when one habit matches at least 75% of its active days. 3 of 8 wallets qualified; the other 5 trade with no habit that simple. Written 2026-10-21 by the main session.

rules.text: Buys about 20 Up shares before the open every single market day, whatever NVDA did the day before (39 of 39 days).
Sells Up after a day NVDA rose and buys Up after a day it fell (12 of 15 active days).
Buys Up when the morning price is above 50 cents and sells it when below (10 of 10 days before the open; a second wallet, 0x9d83, does the same 8 of 9).
